songs.lyrics:
[Cold Open]
Colors on the Street

[Verse 1]
I stepped outside not expecting much
just coffee, just the usual walk
The frost had turned the whole street golden
red and amber on every stalk
I stood a while before the doorstep
surprised by something so plain and slow
The season changed while I wasn't looking
and left this color for me to know

[Chorus]
Colors on the Street
every leaf a little more than before
surprised by something so plain and slow
I'm grateful, standing at my door

[Verse 2]
The air had turned, sharp and quiet
carrying the smell of something new
I walked farther than I ever meant to
just to keep the color in my view
Nothing asked of me this morning
nothing but to notice, to be still
The whole street wore its autumn color
and I let it, standing on the hill

[Bridge]
Some mornings offer nothing special
some mornings offer gold for free
I didn't plan on being grateful
but the color convinced me easily
convinced me before I'd had my coffee

[Chorus]
Colors on the Street
every leaf a little more than before
surprised by something so plain and slow
I'm grateful, standing at my door

[Final Chorus]
Colors on the Street
every leaf brighter than before
still, but I am grateful
I'm grateful, standing at my door
Colors on the Street

songs.lyrics:
[Cold Open]
Let the House Breathe

[Verse 1]
I threw the curtains back this afternoon
sunlight found the dust and moved it clean
Every pane swung open to the garden
first warm breath the house has seen
Winter left its heavy quiet
folded up in every room
Now the breeze comes softly moving
through the hallway, through the gloom
I hadn't noticed how the house had
learned to hold its breath so long

[Chorus]
Let the House Breathe
open wide, and let it in
every heavy month behind us
spring is finally beginning

[Verse 2]
I carried out the winter blankets
shook the porch off, swept the floor
The whole house seemed to lift itself up
lighter than it was before
A bird had found the garden early
the whole yard smelled green and new
I stood between the open panes
and felt the winter falling through
Every corner caught a little of it
every room breathed something clean and slow

[Chorus]
Let the House Breathe
open wide, and let it in
every heavy month behind us
spring is finally beginning

[Breakdown]
No hurry left in either room
just bare windows, just the quiet
just a house gently letting go

[Final Chorus]
Let the House Breathe
let every room lift and lighten
lighter now, and it's certain
after such a long, heavy winter
spring is finally beginning
Let the House Breathe
